correctness.rationale: Cutting the rank-n circle at the unique a_n leaves the path UU for U=Z_(n−1). Since m≤|U|, windows avoiding a_n have precisely the old circular factor set. The other m starts each contain the marker once, so there is a unique marker-first rotation. With j letters before the marker, its tail Q_j has at position t the ruler letter P_t when t≤m−1−j and P_(m−t) when t≥m−j, by palindromicity. Thus every position t not divisible by B=2^ν₂(m) is unchanged as j varies because ν₂(t)=ν₂(m−t). Every B-multiple crossing the cut changes its letter: t/B and (m−t)/B have opposite parity. For j in block q exactly the multiple positions B,2B,…,(d−q−1)B are on the prefix side, where d=m/B. This distinguishes every two different blocks, not only successive ones, and covers d=1 and m=1 without a boundary exception. The new classes are disjoint from old classes because of the marker, and iteration begins just after the first admissible base rank. Independent bounded replay used a valuation-built word, modular extraction of every start, and explicit least-rotation representatives. All 120 (n,m) cases for ranks 2–7 passed (10,548 starts at the larger ranks, 5,214 at the previous ranks, including 2,667 marker starts in the former).
residual_risks: The finite replay corroborates but does not prove the all-rank result. The proof is for distinct literal letters and admissible lengths, not morphic images or longer windows.

evidence: Cassaigne et al. give a periodicity criterion and Sturmian comparisons, as well as a count of two conjugacy classes at twice Fibonacci lengths for a morphic image. Rytter–Shur use Zimin variables for pattern recognition and Fibonacci-factor analysis. The Thue–Morse comparator gives dyadic conjugacy inflation under length doubling in a fixed infinite word.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Shared ruler or dyadic structure and the shared cyclic-complexity definition are not broader theorems specializing to the marker-first window equivalences here. In particular the frozen transport changes the rank at fixed m, not the length in a fixed language.

evidence: The suffix-array/BWT finding sorts full rotations; the palindrome finding explicitly distinguishes strings, not their conjugacy classes. The Thue–Morse length inflation has a different word and operation.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: None of the inspected statements forces distinctness of nonadjacent marker blocks. Here the separator exposes a ruler letter comparison at multiples of 2^ν₂(m), giving exactly the missing distinction.

evidence: Cassaigne–Fici–Sciortino–Zamboni define the cyclic complexity of an infinite word by counting conjugacy classes of factors of fixed length. The frozen problem instead counts necklace representatives realized among factors of a finite one-turn circle and compares ranks.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Even identifying circular windows with factors of a periodic repetition does not import the claimed exact law: the cited bounds and infinite-family characterizations do not compare these consecutive periods or identify their marker classes.

originality.rationale: The best verified comparisons cover cyclic factor complexity in infinite words, conjugacy inflation for a different sequence, and exact finite Zimin circular indices or other factor statistics. The supported distinction is the exact rank increment and equality partition of marker-window conjugacy classes in this finite circular family. The proof requires the specific unique marker, circular-cut structure and positionwise noncollision. Historical priority is not certified. The frozen prior-work description of the Cassaigne et al. paper is broader than the inspected main statements support; credit that paper for cyclic complexity, its periodicity and Sturmian results, and related Fibonacci examples, not for that list of primary word families.

value.rationale: This is an all-length comparison for a canonical recursive word family and a standard rotation invariant, not an isolated count. It determines all the new equivalence classes, including exactly when independently indexed windows merge, and gives the exact slope of every fixed-length sequence of counts. The way the positionwise ruler comparison compresses m new starts to its odd part is a structural result not supplied by a full-word BWT or a palindrome spectrum.
residual_risks: The result is an increment law rather than a formula for every initial count; it does not assert fixed-alphabet transport.
